name: predictor-ai
description: AI-powered trading copilot — run backend and frontend together

scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
